recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，以核深染的小淋巴球為主，並散布大量破碎的污斑細胞（smudge cells），其間夾雜細胞質較多、核較大的中大型淋巴樣細胞，大小不一，符合 CLL 混合細胞型。
features: Marked lymphocytosis with nucleated cells scattered throughout the field at low power
Predominant small lymphocytes with dense dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Numerous smudge cells with pale, disrupted chromatin
Admixed medium-to-large lymphoid cells with more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin
Occasional mature neutrophil; red cells normocytic with rouleaux-like overlap and drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. A distinct subset of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin is admixed, producing a heterogeneous appearance; nucleoli cannot be assessed reliably at this magnification. Occasional neutrophils are present and red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia of mixed cell type; higher-power review to quantify prolymphocytes and flow cytometric confirmation with exclusion of mantle cell lymphoma are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows fewer smudge cells and more irregular nuclei and is cyclin D1-positive, CD23-negative, and CD200-negative with t(11;14).
Prolymphocytic leukemia has more than 55% nucleolated prolymphocytes, whereas small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells dominate here.
Reactive lymphocytosis is polymorphous with abundant cytoplasm, lacks the large number of smudge cells, and is polytypic by flow cytometry.
